title: Goopy
description: This card gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. When played, permanently increase this card's [gold]Block[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue].
notes: The enchanted card gains the Exhaust keyword. When played, the enchantment's amount increases by 1, permanently increasing the card's block by (amount - 1). The card starts with amount 1, so the first play grants 0 bonus block, the second play grants 1 bonus block, and so on.
